exact: regulation of odontogenesis of dentine-containing teeth
regulation of odontogenesis of dentine-containing tooth

definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the formation and development of teeth, the hard, bony appendages which are borne on the jaws, or on other bones in the walls of the mouth or pharynx of most vertebrates.
label: regulation of odontogenesis of dentin-containing tooth
